name: 雀夢麻雀(Mahjong Dream)
detailed_description:
Game Introduction

The ultimate 3D anime-style mahjong game — Mahjong Dream is now available!

"Captain, wake up! It's time for mahjong!"

As the captain, you will lead your team in Mahjong Dream, using exceptional mahjong skills and strategic thinking to conquer the challenges of another world. Train unique mahjong warriors with extraordinary abilities and unlock exclusive stories with them! Compete against mahjong enthusiasts from around the globe and experience various game modes such as 3-player mahjong, 4-player mahjong, ranking matches, and custom rooms. Easy to learn and play, enjoy the thrill of mahjong anytime, anywhere! Download now and embark on your action-packed mahjong adventure!

Game Features

◆ Characters and Scenes: Fully 3D-rendered characters and scenes that seamlessly blend anime style with mahjong elements

◆ Variety of Game Modes: Enjoy multiple game modes for free, catering to both beginners and advanced players

◆ Play with Friends: Create custom rooms and tournaments to enjoy exciting matches with friends online

◆ Immersive Gameplay: Dynamic animations and stunning effects provide an unparalleled mahjong experience that breaks the fourth wall

◆ Customization Options: Adorable character expressions, a variety of voice content, and in-game decorations enhance the fun of each match

※ All currencies, items, and characters in the game are virtual assets and cannot be exchanged for cash or any form of real-world rewards.

short_description: "Mahjong Dream" is the world's first 3D anime-style multiplayer, cross-platform mahjong and card game. It includes Riichi, Sichuan, Taiwanese, Hong Kong Mahjong, Dou Dizhu, Guandan, and more. Lead anime-style mahjong warriors to conquer the competitive mahjong world.
